description: Get a package's open metadata from ecosyste.ms — description, homepage, repository, license, latest version, monthly downloads, and dependent/usage counts. Works across 100+ registries. Keyless.

name.description: Package name, e.g. "react", "@vue/cli", "django". Scopes/slashes are handled automatically.

registry.description: Registry name (default "npmjs.org"). e.g. "pypi.org", "crates.io", "rubygems.org", "nuget.org". Use list_registries to discover names.

name: get_package
title: Get Package
